text:
rachel: quick brain-dump — prototyping a credit-based allocator for elective demotes to avoid the all-or-nothing waves that spike p99 during host-stage. wanted to share the thinking and get feedback.

mira: brief summary of the problem?

rachel: when staging triggers we see many tenants issue demotes simultaneously. that floods compaction workers, causes tiny serial compactions, and the hotset oscillates. result: 2-6s p99 blips and cache churn.

piyush: yeah saw that on the replay. credits sounds promising. how do you allocate credits? equal share? priority?

rachel: three levers: (1) base fair-share credits per tenant, (2) tenant priority boost (for paid tiers), (3) dynamic scaling by recent hotness. credits replenish on a sliding window.

kent: what's the unit of a credit? one demote op? or size-weighted?

rachel: size-weighted. 1 credit ~= 64KB demoted (configurable). so a big blob costs multiple credits. we also cap concurrent demotes to avoid compaction overload.

mira: how do we avoid starving low-priority tenants during long drains?

rachel: soft guarantees: every tenant gets a minimum emergency credit bucket (emergency_credit) that only gets used if free_pages_pct drops below emergency_threshold. normal credits can't be hoarded beyond window. plus, a small fraction (e.g., 5%) of demote throughput reserved for low-priority tenants by default.

piyush: what's the decision path when a tenant requests a demote? pseudocode please.

rachel: pseudo:

``
# on demote request
cost = ceil(bytes / credit_size)
if free_pages_pct < emergency_threshold:
  allow_demote(emergency=true)
elif tenant.credits >= cost and global_inflight_compactions < compaction_cap:
  tenant.credits -= cost
  schedule_demote()
else:
  deny_demote(reason=\"credit_or_capacity\")
  emit_metric(\"demote_denied\", tenant)
``

mira: and credits reacquire? sliding window says credits += rate per second?

rachel: yes. credits regenerate at tenant_credit_rate per second up to a per-window cap. we tested with a 60s window in sim.

kent: compaction coalescing — how do you avoid many small compactions from approved demotes?

rachel: couple tactics: (A) coalesce demotes within a short batch window (50-150ms) into a single compaction if contiguous pages; (B) if scheduled demotes target many tiny pages, merge into a larger compaction job that prefers locality. compaction scheduler uses a priority queue: larger coalesced jobs preferred.

piyush: can this interact badly with KV cache that expects small granularity?

rachel: we keep compaction metadata so the runtime can stream results back as partial availability. i.e., job can mark smaller subranges as \"ready\" as it's flushed so requests can start using portions earlier.

mira: telemetry we should add before canary?

rachel: yes:
- tenant.credits_remaining (gauge)
- demote_denied.count by tenant and reason
- compactions.coalesced.size histogram
- compaction_inflight count
- p99_by_tenant while credits_rate_limited

kent: rollout and safety?

rachel: rollout: feature-flagged off; enable in QA cluster; then a 5-node prod pilot; monitor 24-72h windows. Safety nets: (1) emergency bypass (free_pages_pct < 4%) forces allow_demote; (2) kill-switch flag to revert; (3) router host_penalty emission to avoid shifting load to other hosts unintentionally.

piyush: edge case: if credit_rate misconfigured low, tenants could gradually be starved and backlog grows. any self-correcting mechanism?

rachel: add a slow auto-scale for credit_rate: if host sees repeated compaction idle (compaction_inflight < low) and p99 elevated due to lack of demotes, we can nudge credit_rate up for a short window. likewise reduce if compaction saturation occurs. also emit alerts: sustained demote_denied > N in 5m.

mira: tests?

rachel: unit tests for credit accounting, boundary tests for emergency bypass, compaction coalesce determinism tests, and an integration sim that replays production traces injecting staging signals. we already ran a 1h sim — p99 improved ~22% for the affected tenant mix and compaction ops dropped 28%. no OOM in the sim.

kent: nice. please also add logs that include decision context: tenant, cost, credits_before, global_inflight_compactions, reason. makes postmortems easier.

piyush: small nit: document the default credit_size and window in config and expose a per-cluster opt-in for tenant_priority_boost.

mem-bot: alert: host-3 compaction_inflight=5 demote_denied=2 free_pages_pct=6.1%

mira: saw the bot alert — good exercise. rachel please open PR with config, telemetry, tests, and a short SRE playbook for toggles + disaster recovery steps. i'll take test review.

rachel: will do, tagging @piyush for scheduler review and @kent for compaction merge logic. thanks all :thumbsup:
